title: Notes
smeacHelp: Write the five SMEAC sections as text for the briefing material.

status.saved: Changes are saved automatically on this device.
status.unavailable: Notes cannot be saved on this device. Input stays until the page closes.
status.corruptTitle: Saved notes cannot be read, so saving is stopped
status.corruptBody: The original data is kept. Setting it aside keeps it in another place and starts from empty notes. Input on screen is lost when set aside, so export it first if needed.
status.setAsideFailed: Could not set the data aside. The original data is unchanged.
status.previousAvailable: A previous version with the same file name has notes

flights.title: Per-flight notes
flights.help: Choose a flight, then write the pilot, TOT, fuel and free notes. Notes that are all empty are not saved.
flights.empty: No flights can be noted in this view
flights.fuelInvalid: Enter a number of 0 or more. This value is not saved.
flights.limit: Notes are limited to {{count}} flights. Clear a flight's notes to add another.

storage.title: Storage and export
storage.help: Notes are saved per mission in this browser. An exported JSON file can be loaded on another device.
storage.pilotNote: In pilot view, only the notes for the flights shown are exported. Map notes are not exported.
storage.importFailed: This file cannot be imported as notes for this mission

board.blockedTitle: The saved board cannot be read, so saving is stopped
board.blockedBody: The board stays on screen only. Setting it aside keeps the saved copy in another place and starts an empty board. The board on screen is lost when set aside, so export it first if needed.
board.setAside: Set aside and start an empty board
board.setAsideFailed: Could not set the board aside. The original board is unchanged.

whiteboard.title: Whiteboard
whiteboard.description: Draw and write on the board. Its content is saved per mission on this device.
whiteboard.memoryOnly: Cannot be saved (lost when the page closes)
whiteboard.pointerOnly: Draw with a mouse or touch. From the keyboard, write in the board notes below.
whiteboard.strokeLimit: This stroke reached its length limit, so nothing more is drawn past this point.
whiteboard.notesHelp: Notes kept with the board. They also appear in the exported material.
whiteboard.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Push at 14:30Z, leave to the north
whiteboard.shareHelp: An exported board can only be imported for the same mission.
whiteboard.importFailed: This board cannot be imported for this mission
